title: The Queen of the Damned
author: Anne Rice
summary: The vampire Lestat has become a rock star, and his music wakes Akasha, the first vampire. She intends to rule humanity, while the world's older vampires scramble to stop her.
readIf: you want lush, philosophical vampire fiction and have read the earlier Vampire Chronicles.
skipIf: you prefer lean, fast horror or would be starting the series here.
